citation: [2140 S. Prairie Ave.] Photograph from the south-east, on Prairie Avenue near 22nd Street, looking west at the Tucker/Smith house with the Murdoch house at 2130 at right; unknown photographer, undated (after 1890). Illustration in Glessner House Museum, 'John M. Van Osdel, Chicago's First Architect', The Story of a House (blog), 31 August 2015.
author: unknown photographer

note: A small print, taken nearer the front of 2130 than the Chicagology photograph: it shows the tower's three stages, its steep slated cone and finial, and the street gable's south rake over the columned porch.
